title: Gallery - Photo Gallery, Vault

description:
Share images, photos, videos, and memories! Lock and share your photos & videos with Gallery Photo & Image Vault! You can secure your images and share photos straight from the app. Besides sharing images and videos, you can recover images, photos, and videos.

Photo Gallery Vault app - Your Private Photo Organizer!

Keep private photos & videos secured in our Gallery Photo Vault! Welcome to Gallery Vault, the ultimate photo gallery tool that offers more than just a place to store and share your precious images. It's your private photo vault, picture vault, and locked photo album all rolled into one. With Photo Gallery Vault, you can control your media, ensuring they're organized, secure, and easily shareable whenever you want!🏆

📸 Gallery Lock app - Explore and Share Your Memories in Style! 📸
Gallery Vault app provides a sleek and intuitive photo gallery where you can effortlessly view your images and watch videos using the built-in HD video player. It's not just a gallery; it's your space to relive and share your favorite moments.

🔒 Picture Vault - Keep Your Memories Secure! 🔒
Worried about prying eyes? No problem! Use our gallery lock feature to protect your private media with a pin code or pattern lock. Your memories remain yours and yours alone with Private Photo Vault!

Picture Vault Key Features:
⚡Private Photo Vault: Keep your images and videos secure in your private vault;
⚡Gallery Vault app: Safeguard your cherished memories with pin code or pattern lock protection;
⚡Photo Organizer: Sort and organize by date, time, events, and location;

⚡Locked Photo Album Editor: Enhance and edit with filters, cropping, and more;
⚡Gallery Lock app: Secure your images;
⚡Share images straight from the app;

Photo Organizer - Organize with Ease!
Private Photo Vault acts as your photo organizer extraordinaire. Sort and arrange by date, time, events, location, and more. Finding that particular picture has never been easier.

🗑️ Recover Deleted Photos and Videos! 🗑️
Mistakenly delete your media? Don't panic! Private Photo Vault automatically saves deleted files in the recycle bin, making recovering them easy even after deletion. Your memories are safe and sound.

🎨 Locked Photo Album & Editor - Dazzle Up Your Pictures! 🎨
Gallery Lock app isn't just about storage and security; it's also a powerful photo organizer tool and locked photo album & editor. Edit on the go, apply filters, and crop to perfection.

Gallery Vault app is the photo gallery tool that does it all. It's your private photo vault, picture vault, photo locker, gallery lock, and photo locker. With the ability to recover deleted photos, it's the ultimate picture vault when you need to keep your images safe, organized, and easily accessible.👍

Create Your Media Space With Picture Vault!


Gallery Lock app is your comprehensive solution for managing, securing, and enhancing your photo gallery collection. Download now and unlock a world of possibilities with Photo Locker and Picture Vault. Take advantage of the opportunity to take control of your images.
